master_password_file.description: Path to file containing the master password; secure alternative to embedding master_password

master_password.description: Master password (insecure if stored in config); prefer master_password_file

realm.description: Realm string (e.g., resource URL or usage identifier) used to derive the password/key

seed_file.description: Path to encrypted seed file (used instead of master password as entropy source)

skip_bytes.description: Number of bytes to skip when reading seed file

output_path.description: Path to write output; default is stdout if empty

key_type.description: Requested output type: pass, seed, raw, ec256, ec384, ec521, rsa2048, rsa4096, x25519, ed25519

length.description: Password length (for pass type) or number of bytes (for raw type)

unsafe_mode.description: If true, allow generating keys without a seed file (not recommended)
